notes.title: 📣 Game Launch 🎊 – *Special Launch Discount for a Limited Time! 🏷️🛒📅
notes.content:
Ankhway: The Interplanetary Legacy is oficcially out now on Steam!
 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175856/13bb1cba4048e88f15554992e814c3e4b62a0b0e.png"][strike]-[/strike] We're excited to finally release the videogame and share it with all of you. To celebrate the launch, we're offering a special price with 20% discount available for the first 14 days only! 🚀


🎮  Whether you're a longtime fan of the indie videogames or just discovering it, this is the perfect time to jump in. 

🧭 Genre: Adventure, Action and Sci-Fi. 


💬 We’d love to hear your feedback, reviews, and see your gameplay screenshots or videos!
      (If you find any problem or want to ask something, you can send an email to: 
     ankhwayvideogamecontact@gmail.com)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175856/aa68129bd807bf3740e346ed5687bb6e2b7aedf6.png"]
⚠️ Don’t miss it/Remember!:
*This price (4,99$ and 20% of discount for the game release) is a special launch price. After the first 14 days, the game will be priced at $7.99.

Thank you for the support from the beginning (Kickstarter Campaing), and we hope you enjoy the game! ːsteamhappyːːsteamthisːːsteamthumbsupː
